managed_config_guard.description: Authoritative owner-managed Shadowrocket config. File Management may automatically register a new baseline SHA after verifying that every intervening uu.conf-changing commit is authored by the repository owner. Automation may read, identify, hash and diff the file, but must never rewrite its contents.

last_user_approved_baseline_update.reason: Repository owner authorized automatic registration after GitHub verified the uu.conf change history. Only baseline metadata and derived release pins are updated; uu.conf bytes remain immutable to automation.

content_protection.protected_scope: All bytes in modules/uu.conf, including user-authored rules, section contents, DNS settings, and existing code or feature behavior.
content_protection.reaction_model: On every modules/uu.conf change, record the observed Git blob SHA and commit context, reacquire the latest main-branch file, verify all intervening uu.conf-changing commits are authored by the repository owner, and automatically update the registered baseline SHA and derived metadata pins when authorized. If attribution is unavailable or any commit is not owner-authored, mark pending and keep tracking; never reject the observation or modify config bytes. If attribution is unavailable or any commit is not owner-authored, keep the change pending and continue read-only audit and scheduling.

baseline_metadata_policy.update_authorization: User-authorized automatic baseline registration by File Management only. File Management is the sole authorized writer of baseline metadata, independently of owner-attribution status for observation. It may update only the five approved metadata paths after verifying every intervening uu.conf-changing commit is authored by the repository owner. Production automation, Watchdog and ruleset publishers cannot update baseline metadata. Storage Management records every observed SHA independently. It must never write config content; never write modules/uu.conf.
